title: Council awards the bridge contract
body: {Lowmoor Town Council:lowmoor-council} voted 7 to 2 to give the bridge contract to {Harbor Works:harbor-works}, ending two years of argument over whether the town could afford a crossing at all. The two votes against came from members who wanted a ferry instead. Construction was expected to begin the following spring.

claims.text: The council voted 7 to 2 for Harbor Works.
claims.quote: voted 7 to 2 on Tuesday to award the bridge contract to Harbor Works Ltd

title: Harbor Works closes bridge financing
body: {River Valley Fund:river-fund} put 40 million into the project three months after the {council vote:ev-contract}. The money covered the steel and the first year of work, and it made the fund the largest private backer of the bridge. {Harbor Works:harbor-works} had warned the council that without outside financing the start date would slip.

claims.quote: secured 40 million in financing from the River Valley Fund
